name: 은빛 격자문
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: Symmetrical corridor-end composition featuring an elaborate silver latticework gate blocking the passage, its fine metal patterns catching cool teal moonlight from behind. The intricate shadows cast onto the stone floor form delicate geometric shapes, warmed by amber wall sconces on either side. Open lower-central foreground before the gate, richly detailed filigree metalwork, quiet symmetrical stillness, no people, no text, no UI.
